request.items: 1..500 records with id UUID and optional optimistic version; preserve the original selection versions
request.confirmReferencedHide: optional boolean; omitted, null or false means the initial command; only Boolean.TRUE enables confirmed reference hiding

response.failed: unsuccessful item count, including items requiring confirmation
response.results: per-record id, label, ok, reason, confirmationRequired and references
response.confirmationRequired: true only for server-approved counterparty reference warnings; permissions and stale-version failures remain false
response.references: bounded, server-authorized records with kind, id and label; the client never reconstructs inaccessible document identities

confirmation: Show 去查看 and 仍然删除 for confirmationRequired items; explain that master lists and new-document choices are hidden while historical documents and balances remain.
去查看 navigates only to the supplied, authorized relationship and sends no delete command.
仍然删除 resends only the confirmationRequired subset, retains each original version, and sets confirmReferencedHide=true.
Permission, object scope and version are rechecked by the server; the confirmation flag is not a general force-delete bypass.
Cancellation, closing, account/dataset changes and repeated clicks must not issue another write; an unknown submission must be reconciled before resubmission.

readAndSelection: Master lists, categories, search, header facets and exports omit hidden counterparty rows according to the owning service query.
New business pickers and new-reference validation omit or reject hidden counterparties; stale picker snapshots cannot create a newly selected hidden reference.
Historical ID lookup and dictionaries preserve the original identity and name; selectable=false is authoritative for new choices.
Historical filters may explicitly request the owning historical candidate mode; do not use a new-business-only list to erase access to old statements.
Existing documents retain their original client/supplier UUID and continue under existing lifecycle, permissions, amount and source guards; hidden status alone does not invalidate them.

ownerPresentation.rule: Use the generated semantic error brush for unassigned owner text; assigned owner labels keep the existing theme style. A shared native owner cell must be used when these pages are migrated.

historicalSnapshotCompatibility.authority: server V995 fn_party_master_history_schema + MasterOperationHistoryService read projection
historicalSnapshotCompatibility.scope: Only clients/suppliers object snapshots: missing is_hidden=false and hidden_at=null. Explicit values, non-object rows and all other tables are unchanged.
historicalSnapshotCompatibility.originalEvidence: Immutable before_row/after_row audit snapshots are not rewritten.
historicalSnapshotCompatibility.personalUndoRedo: Both service/SQL CAS and existing cross-operation token lineage use the same server normalization. Hidden=true, non-null hidden_at or any other actual subsequent change still fails CAS.
historicalSnapshotCompatibility.objectVersionRestore: Existing commandHead and alignedTarget behavior is retained: restoring an old version without hidden fields preserves current hidden-state values.
historicalSnapshotCompatibility.nativeConsumer: Use the authoritative server result; do not implement a second snapshot-normalization or CAS rule in the native client.
